instructions: Set the oven to 200°F and put a rack on a baking sheet in it to keep the cooked pitas warm.
Grate half the onion on the large holes of a box grater into a large bowl. Finely grate 2 of the garlic cloves into the bowl. Finely chop 1/4 cup of the parsley and add it.
Add the beef, coriander, cumin, allspice, cinnamon, paprika and 1 1/4 tsp of the salt. Mix with your hands for about 30 seconds, until it's evenly combined.
Cut each pita in half and open each half into a pocket. If one tears or won't open, microwave it for 30 seconds.
Divide the meat into 10 portions. Flatten each into a half-circle a little smaller than a pita half, then slide it into a pocket and press it out toward the edges.
Brush both sides of each stuffed pita with the olive oil, using 2 tbsp for all ten.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add 3 or 4 stuffed pitas, leaving a little room between them. Cook for 2 minutes per side, pressing lightly with a spatula, until golden and crisp.
You're cooking the beef to 160°F in the middle, so if you have a thermometer, check it there. No thermometer? Open one pita and check that the meat has no pink left.
Transfer the cooked pitas to the rack in the oven. Cook the rest in the same way. That takes 2 more rounds.

While the last batch cooks, make the sauce. In a bowl, whisk the yogurt, tahini, juice of the lemon, the last garlic clove, the remaining 1/2 tsp salt and 1 tbsp water until it looks like soft whipped cream.
Put the sauce in a bowl on the table, with the cayenne in a small dish for anyone who wants heat. Serve the arayes whole or cut in half, with the tahini yogurt sauce.
Taste the sauce. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt or a squeeze of lemon.
method_notes: Comes in at about 31 minutes, a touch over 30, because three rounds in the skillet add up. The lead is RecipeTin Eats (4.98 from 106): raw spiced meat in pita halves, pan-fried until crisp, with a whipped tahini yogurt sauce. I kept its 10 half pita format and moved the cayenne to the table. The other versions agree on raw kafta in a pita pocket that's crisped on both sides, and they add parsley, allspice and cinnamon, so I added parsley and a little cinnamon to the lead's spice mix. To avoid the pan, bake them at 400°F for 15 to 20 minutes, flipping halfway.
